hero.headlineMain: Frame yourself properly on every call.
hero.headlineSub: Crop, zoom and frame your webcam, right in the browser.
hero.description: Crop, zoom and frame your webcam right in the browser, on Meet, Zoom and every other call — with nothing leaving your machine.
hero.visualAlt: Before and after: a webcam feed goes from off-center and cluttered to framed and centered with CamTuner

problem.title: Laptop webcams weren't made for calls.
problem.description: You look smaller, darker and further away on camera than you do in person — and none of it is your fault.

pains.title: Wrong shape
pains.description: 4:3 feeds leave awkward bars or clumsy crops on every call app.

pains.title: Off-center
pains.description: You drift to the edge of the frame while half the shot is empty room.

pains.title: Too far away
pains.description: Wide-angle lenses turn you into a tiny figure in your own meeting.

pains.title: Messy background
pains.description: Laundry, cables, roommates — whatever's behind you is in the shot too.

problem.bridge: CamTuner fixes all four before the call app sees a single frame.

worksWith.label: Works on any site that uses your camera

showcase.title: Tune it live. Right here.
showcase.description: Start your camera and scroll. Every control below is the real thing, the same ones you get inside the extension.

sections.title: Pick the shape of your shot
sections.description: Choose an aspect ratio, then decide whether the leftover space is padded with bars in any color or cropped away entirely.

sections.title: Move in without moving the camera
sections.description: Dial in a fixed zoom, or switch to auto and let CamTuner keep you at the right size as you lean in and out.

sections.title: Put yourself exactly where you want
sections.description: Anchor your shot to any of nine positions, or switch to Auto and let Center Stage track your face to keep you framed as you move. Tracking runs locally, so no video is ever uploaded.

sections.title: Tidy up what's behind you
sections.description: Blur a messy room or swap it for an image. Person segmentation happens on your device, frame by frame.

sections.title: Correct the orientation
sections.description: Mirror your feed or flip it vertically for webcams and rigs that come out the wrong way around.

install.title: Installed in under a minute
install.description: Three steps and your next call looks better. There's nothing to configure on the meeting side.

steps.title: Add it to Chrome
steps.description: One click from the Chrome Web Store. Pin the icon so it's always within reach.

steps.title: Tune your shot
steps.description: Open the popup and set your ratio, zoom and alignment. Changes show up instantly.

steps.title: Join any call
steps.description: Pick your camera as usual in Meet, Zoom or anywhere else. Your settings are already applied.

features.title: Small extension. Big difference.
features.subtitle: Everything you need to fix a bad camera angle, nothing you don't.

cards.title: Zero-latency framing
cards.description: CamTuner hooks the browser's camera stream directly, so adjustments are applied in real time with no visible delay.

cards.title: Private by design
cards.description: Frames are processed locally with WebCodecs. No video, audio or settings ever leave your machine.

cards.title: Works everywhere
cards.description: If a website can ask for your camera, CamTuner can tune it. No per-app setup.

cards.title: Your look, remembered
cards.description: Settings persist between sessions, and you can set different framing per site.

items.a: Yes. It's a free extension with no account, no trial and no watermark.

items.q: Does my video get uploaded anywhere?
items.a: No. Everything is processed on your device inside the browser. Your camera feed is never sent to us or to any server.

items.q: Which video call apps does it work with?
items.a: Any website that uses your webcam through the browser, including Google Meet, Zoom in the browser, Microsoft Teams, Discord and more.

items.q: Will it slow down my computer?
items.a: Cropping and zooming are very light. Face tracking and background effects use more CPU, so you can switch them on only when you need them.

items.q: Do I need to change settings in Zoom or Meet?
items.a: No. Keep using your normal camera. CamTuner adjusts the stream before the site ever sees it.

cta.headline: Your next call, framed properly.
cta.description: Add CamTuner to Chrome in one click. It's free, and it takes less than a minute.
